description: This file is a shell script that provides an interoperability testing framework for software components, primarily involving git versions. It includes functions for building specific git versions, creating wrapper scripts for git commands, and setting up the testing environment.

methods.name: build_version
methods.description: Builds a specific version of git or a specific commit/tree, returning the directory path where it was built.

methods.name: wrap_git
methods.description: Creates a wrapper script to emulate older git versions lacking certain features.

methods.name: generate_wrappers
methods.description: Creates wrapper scripts for git commands to ensure compatibility during testing.
